Welcome to My Quick Trippers - Where every journey begins with a heartfelt Namaste.

We have been crafting unforgettable travel experiences that go beyond sightseeing, immersing you deeply in the soul-stirring beauty, rich heritage, and vibrant diversity of India and destinations around the world.

As one of India’s most trusted and award-winning travel companies, we are proud to be recognized among the top travel agencies in Delhi and India, setting new benchmarks in excellence, authenticity, and personalized care.

Our name is our promise. “Namaste”—a recognition of the sacred connection between host and guest—guides every interaction. It is the essence of our heartfelt hospitality, our respectful partnership with local communities, and our commitment to creating journeys that resonate long after the journey ends.

With multiple offices across major cities and trusted associates overseas, My Quick Trippers offers a diverse range of services designed to fulfill every traveler's dream. We specialize in India Tour Packages, International Tours, Pilgrimage & Spiritual Tours, Leisure & Luxury Tours, Group & Family Tours, Helicopter Tours, Adventure Tours, Cruise Packages, Wellness Packages, Educational Trips, Corporate Travel, and Charter Services.

We provide a seamless online booking experience with great offers on flights, hotels, and complete holiday packages at the best prices. Our transparent, hassle-free process ensures you can plan your dream journey with confidence and ease.

Founded in 2010, My Quick Trippers has grown from a passionate dream into a travel powerhouse trusted by thousands worldwide. With over 15 years of experience in the industry and more than 30,000 travelers journeying with us annually, we have established ourselves as pioneers in delivering exceptional travel experiences across India and beyond.

Our growth is not measured merely in numbers, but in the countless memories we've helped create, the smiles we've witnessed, and the lifelong relationships we've built with travelers from every corner of the globe.

Our journey began not in boardrooms, but on bustling railway platforms, at serene Himalayan dawns, in the spice-scented lanes of ancient markets, and amidst the timeless chants of temple towns. We are travelers turned storytellers, explorers turned guides, and hosts who welcome you not as clients, but as honored guests into the grand, vibrant narrative of India.

We understand that India can be overwhelming—a beautiful, glorious, chaotic symphony. That's where our magic lies. We listen to the whisper of your wanderlust and compose a journey that speaks directly to your spirit. Whether you seek the tranquil silence of meditation in Rishikesh, the spiritual vibration of Kedarnath, the first light of dawn gilding the Taj Mahal's marble dome, the royal elegance of Rajasthan's palaces, the tropical serenity of Kerala's backwaters, or the profound spiritual energy of Varanasi's ghats—we translate your desires into flawless reality.

What began as a small team of passionate travel enthusiasts has blossomed into an award-winning tour operator, recognized by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India, and honored with numerous accolades for our contributions to Indian tourism.

We invite you to step beyond the ordinary. Let us guide you from the iconic to the intimate, from the majestic to the mystical. Come, write your own chapter in the eternal story of India. With My Quick Trippers, you don't just see India—you feel it, breathe it, and become part of its beautiful, eternal dance.
We invite you to explore with us. Let's turn your travel dreams into your next beautiful story.
Welcome. Your journey begins with a Namaste.

India isn't just a destination—it's a feeling, an awakening, a journey of the soul. We believe that every traveler deserves to experience the authentic heartbeat of this incredible land, from the snow-capped peaks of the Himalayas to the sun-kissed beaches of Kerala, from the majestic forts of Rajasthan to the serene ghats of Varanasi.

To Our Travelers: Every journey with us is backed by our unwavering commitment to quality, safety, and authentic experiences. From luxury palace hotels to cozy homestays, from private chauffeurs to expert local guides, we ensure every detail exceeds your expectations.

To Our Planet: We practice responsible tourism, supporting local communities and minimizing environmental impact. For every booking, we contribute 1% to local social causes, ensuring your journey creates positive ripples.

To Our Promise: Transparent pricing with no hidden costs, flexible cancellation policies, and the assurance that your dream vacation is protected by a financially sound, government-recognized company.

Language should never be a barrier to discovery. That's why we've pioneered the concept of Linguistic Trade Guides fluent in Russian, Spanish, Italian, German, French, and all major Indian languages. Our multilingual experts don't just translate—they transform your understanding, helping you connect deeply with local cultures, traditions, and people.
Come, let us show you India through our eyes—where every monument tells a story, every festival celebrates life, every meal is a celebration, and every journey becomes a cherished memory.
Ready to discover the magic of India? Contact us today and let's begin crafting your perfect Indian odyssey.
To be India’s most trusted travel brand, inspiring the world to explore with curiosity, respect, and a deeper connection — while showcasing the true essence of India with world-class hospitality.

Our mission is to redefine travel with world-class service, smart technology, and sustainable tourism. To create a community of happy travelers by professionally planned holidays with a personal touch.
We aim to make exploration accessible to all, while celebrating India’s culture, supporting local communities, and ensuring every traveler returns with memories that last a lifetime.
You don’t just travel with us — you discover, you connect, you experience, you transform from within.

Every journey with My Quick Trippers is woven with untold stories, heartfelt emotions, and the timeless warmth of Indian hospitality. We don't show you India — we help you feel its heartbeat, breathe its spirit, and carry its magic home in your soul.

From the sacred chants echoing in temple corridors to the vibrant chaos of bustling bazaars, from sunrise over the Himalayas to sunset on serene backwaters — we craft moments that become memories, and memories that become part of who you are.
This is not tourism. This is transformation. This is India, experienced the way it was meant to be — with reverence, authenticity, and an open heart.
Recognition That Reflects Our Commitment to Excellence

At My Quick Trippers, our dedication to delivering world-class travel experiences has been recognized by leading industry bodies and government authorities. Our certifications and awards are not just accolades—they're a testament to our unwavering commitment to quality, safety, and customer satisfaction.
These certifications ensure that every aspect of your journey—from booking to execution—meets the highest standards of professionalism, safety, and service excellence.
From Exploring 44+ Countries to Creating India's Most Trusted Travel Brand—A Journey to Help Others Discover Themselves
Roam the world, O ignorant, while you can; you won’t get this life again and even if there is some life left, your youth will not remain

These profound words didn't just inspire me—they ignited a fire within that transformed my entire existence. I am not just a travel professional; I am a traveler at heart, and that distinction makes all the difference.

My journey began in 2002, not with a business plan, but with an insatiable curiosity to understand the world beyond textbooks and a restless spirit that refused to settle. What started as personal exploration evolved into a lifelong passion that has taken me across every corner of India and over 44+ countries worldwide. From the spiritual peaks of the Himalayas to the ancient temples of Southeast Asia, from the historic landmarks of Europe to the exotic landscapes of the Middle East—each journey taught me that travel is not about destinations; it's about transformation.

While passion fuels the heart, expertise guides the path. With an MBA in Travel and Tourism Management and 16 years of professional experience in the travel industry, I've combined academic rigor with real-world insights to build a travel brand that delivers world-class services. My education provided the framework, but the roads taught me the nuances—the difference between a good itinerary and an unforgettable experience, between showing places and creating connections.

Having explored over 44+ countries, I've experienced tourism from every angle—as a solo explorer, a family traveler, a luxury seeker, and a spiritual pilgrim. I've witnessed exceptional hospitality and disappointing service. I've seen how the right guide can bring history alive and how poor planning can ruin dream vacations. These experiences crystallized my vision: to deliver world-class services to travelers and create the best travel itineraries that don't just showcase destinations but touch souls.

India, my homeland, deserves to be experienced with the same depth and care I've witnessed in the world's best tourism destinations. Every pilgrimage route, every heritage site, every cultural experience we offer at My Quick Trippers is designed with the insight of someone who has walked those paths, understood those stories, and felt those emotions firsthand.

When you choose My Quick Trippers, you're not just booking with a travel agency—you're trusting a fellow traveler who has spent two decades understanding what makes journeys memorable. My vision extends beyond business success; it's about creating a legacy where every traveler experiences India with the same wonder, respect, and deep connection that has defined my own journey.

I've walked the Char Dham circuits, meditated in Varanasi's ghats, explored Rajasthan's forts, cruised Kerala's backwaters, trekked Kashmir's meadows, and witnessed sunrise at the Taj Mahal countless times—not just to inspect them as products, but to understand them as experiences. This intimate knowledge ensures that when I design your itinerary, it comes from authentic experience, not brochures.

Those beautiful Urdu verses that sparked my journey remind me daily that life is fleeting and the world is vast. The poet's wisdom resonates deeper with each passing year—youth doesn't wait, opportunities don't linger, and the world's wonders are meant to be experienced, not postponed. Every day I don't help someone discover the transformative power of travel feels like a missed opportunity. This urgency, this passion, this commitment to excellence—that's what My Quick Trippers represents.

With government approvals, industry awards, and recognition as one of India's top travel brands, we've earned trust through consistent quality. But what truly drives me isn't accolades—it's the messages from travelers whose perspectives shifted, whose spirits awakened, and whose lives changed after experiencing India through our carefully crafted journeys.

Whether you're seeking spiritual enlightenment in sacred temples, royal grandeur in heritage palaces, natural beauty in pristine landscapes, or luxury experiences in world-class properties—I bring 16 years of expertise, global insights from 44+ countries, and the heart of a traveler who still feels excitement before every journey.

Let's turn that poetic wisdom into your reality. The world awaits, youth is fleeting, and India's magic is calling. Trust me to craft your perfect journey—because I'm not just planning your trip; I'm sharing what I've spent a lifetime discovering.

At My Quick Trippers, we are deeply committed to protecting the environment and promoting responsible tourism across India. We actively work to reduce our ecological footprint by designing smart, efficient travel itineraries that minimize unnecessary travel distances and avoid overcrowded destinations or peak-rush hours.

Our team encourages every traveler to explore India in a more mindful, eco-friendly way — respecting nature, local communities, and cultural heritage. Sustainability is at the heart of our philosophy, and we continuously strive to create travel experiences that are both memorable and environmentally responsible.
NIT makes arrangements with a plethora of safe, comfortable and secure hotels, ranging from budget to luxurious, boutique to chain brands, as per every client’s needs.

Our food menu is diverse and the clients have the freedom to choose from the following choice of meals that includes cuisines from national and international destinations of South India, North Indian and Jain food to Mexican, Italian, Thai, Chinese food, Japanese food, American food and so much more.
Throughout your trip you will be made to enjoy privacy as well as shared smooth transfers throughout the trip as mentioned in your itinerary.

The tourism vehicle usage is to take visitors sightseeing, with routes around tourist attractions, which determine the vehicle is a key factor for a comfortable and relaxing tour. Our vehicles all are the latest model of leading brand with full functional condition.
We provide multiple models of vehicle as per your group size:

In addition to providing all day comfort, maintained daily and serviced by a local automotive shop that is Road Transport Bureau certified, you can rest assured that your touring vehicle will be safe and well-maintained.
Usually, tour guide is the most important part of a trip. Either on a half day tour or a multi-country itinerary, the tourist guide makes a difference.

Tour guide of My Quick Trippers, professional and rich experience are indispensable. We do go through a very strong selection process and it really depends on the group’s needs and wishes, the tour guide we assign.

They do love what they do. They love the country, nature and whatever their expertise is. Our guides have to be passionate about their work and love to teach and to share. They will go that extra mile in making your travel come alive, always with a smile.

Available Languages: English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, Italian, Spanish, Indonesian and etc. For more detail available language in your tour country, please consult with our tailor-made tour specialist.

Shopping is a fun experience that we make sure to arrange at least 1 or 2 stops at each destination. This is done to fully immerse you into having a deeply local experience and to give you an opportunity to contribute to the local businesses as wee by buying souvenirs, cultural items like folk art and traditional handicraft, luxury items, for yourself and loved ones. The clients have the liberty to make purchases from anywhere they like. We don’t take any responsibility for any items purchased nor do we recommend any particular shop/establishment.

Online Booking: You can purchase our services from our sales outlets, or you can register and book your tour/services online through our website. Our website provides the facility of making online booking of tours and services. After confirmation in written from you an agreement made between you and us.
For the services contracted, a minimum deposit of 25% of the total cost is to be paid by you to My Quick Trippers . The deposit is required to hold the booking on confirmed basis.

The balance payment is to be paid 15 days prior to the date of start of services. Any booking made within 15 working days of the date of services would be considered as a late booking and for same the full and final payment is required to be made at the time of booking itself.
Note:

Apart from the above, in the case of bookings for special train journeys, hotel or resort bookings during the peak season (X-Mas, New Year, Pushkar Fair, Diwali, etc), full payment is required to be made at the time of booking itself.

Even after making the 25% advance to confirm your bookings, in some cases it might be required that you need to pay an additional advance amount before the final balance payment date, depending on the hotel’s specific policy or contractor/supplier’s payment deadline as and when applicable.
Special Note:

Please note that My Quick Trippers Pvt. Ltd employee or agent will not ask for your Card Number, CVV, Net Banking login, Password, OTP etc. Nor will they ask you to transfer funds to a personal account or to install third-party apps like Any Desk, TeamViewer, etc.
Please do not act on such a request. Report such incidents to info@myquicktrippers.com
Payments: All payments are to be paid in behalf of My Quick Trippers .

1. By Cash / Cheque / Demand Draft 2. By Electronic money transfer (RTGS & NEFT) 3. By Mail Authorization (AMEX, Visa & Master Card) 4. By Online Payment Gateway system through Amex, Visa & Master Card 5. By Debit Card.
1. By Bank transfer to our bank (Bank Details) 2. By Mail Authorization (AMEX, Visa & Master Card) 3. By Online Payment Gateway system through AMEX, Visa & Master Card. 4. By Debit card.
In case of payment through credit card, the bank charges (3% extra) – would be levied over and above the total amount.

Note: 1. All payments should be free and clear of any withholding tax and deduction. 2. Bank charges, if any, for remittance (by remitting bank or by intermediary bank) would be strictly borne by payer.

In case of cancellation of tour or travel services due to any reason, you are requested Please inform us in writing. Cancellation charges would be effective from the date we receive letter in writing and cancellation charges would be as follows: Cancellation charges for any mode of transport ticket are applicable as per the rules of the concerned authority. Air ticket issued on special fare are non-refundable and the guest shall bear cancellation charges. Group Tours If the reservation is canceled 30 days prior to the date of arrival – 90% may be refunded (except the transaction charges) If the reservation is canceled 15 days prior to the date of arrival – 50% of the may be refunded (except the transaction charges)} If the reservation is cancelled 07 days prior to the date of arrival – 25% of the may be refunded (except the transaction charges). If the cancellation is any later than the above stated period or in case of ‘No Show’- No Refund. No refund or any changes will be accepted at last minute for tour starting or after starting or middle of the tour. Individual Tours (FIT Tours) Cancellation policy of Individual tours is subject to changes. It depends upon the cancellation policy of the respective hotels and other service operators your tour is associated with. Different hotels and service operators have different cancellation policies which we are required to abide by. In the unfortunate event of cancellation of trip by guests, we would charge 8% of total booking amount as processing charges + the charges levied by the corresponding service providers.

In case of special train journey (like Palace on Wheels, Royal Rajasthan on Wheels, Deccan Odyssey, Golden Chariot, Indian Maharaja & Maharajas Express) – a separate cancellation policy is applicable (which would be advised as and when required). For high peak season bookings (from 20th Dec to 15th Jan) – please note that if the booking for high peak season is/are cancelled, due to whatsoever reason, no refund would be made for said cancellation. During “Peak-Season,” which is defined by the density of tourist inflow in each region, and may vary from place to place and hotel to hotel, any particular hotel may implement a different cancellation policy. The travel agent is bound to follow the hotel specific cancellation policy; and in case of variation from the above-stated policy, the excess in cancellation charges will be borne by the client and not the travel agent. In case you cancel the trip after commencement, refund would be restricted to a limited amount that too would depend on the amount that we would be able to recover from the hoteliers we patronize. For unused hotel accommodation, chartered transportation and missed meals etc. we do not take any guarantee to refund. Modifications/Cancellations sent directly to the hotel will not be honored. In regard to unused or unutilized services (which are paid for and cancelled well in advanced) the refunds amounts would be worked out on the basis of cancellation policy as described above, any refund against a payment received through a Credit Card, will be made on the same credit card only. Please note that the refund process may take 2 to 8 weeks due to banking procedures. No deductions will be made for the refunds (except the transaction charges), which are made due to unavailability of services. If the services requested are unavailable during the requested period, we will offer similar alternatives well before the commencement of the services and if the client does not find the alternatives acceptable, the advance will be refunded. However, once the alternative service is accepted by the client, cancellation of the same will be subject to the above-stated cancellation policy. No Refund for Unused Services It is clearly understood that there shall be no refund or compensation whatsoever for unutilized services. This general rule applies to all kinds of non-utilization or under-utilization of tour services, whether of the whole or part of the tour and whether as a matter of your choice, or caused by your fault or compelled by circumstances such as ill-health, weather, external factors etc. There will be no refund if you fail to or are unable to utilize any of the services on the tour like airline travel, hotels, sightseeing, rides, cruises, meals, entrance fees, optional tours etc due to any reason whatsoever such as late reporting, ill-health etc.

(1) Check-In Timings: 1200 – 1500 Hours. (2) Early arrival is subject to availability. For guaranteed early check-in, reservation needs to be made starting from the previous night. (3) Check-Out Timings: 1000 – 1200 Hours. (4) Late check-outs are available on request and subject to availability / Payment.

Please note that the cost of extra usage of vehicle (cars/coaches with the driver) is not included in the services and hence extra usage of Vehicle after transfer or after sightseeing is not allowed until unless it is mentioned in the detailed itinerary/services.

Please note: After the finalization of the tour or service cost, if there are any hikes in entrance fees of monuments, museums, taxes, fuel cost or guide charges by the Govt. of India, the same would be charged as extra.
The contents of web pages may not always be fully updated. We therefore ask you to confirm the current information by contacting us.

The itinerary may have changed. The products and services displayed may have changed. The photos of meals/sightseeing are for reference and may differ from the actual meals/sights. Distance between places and temperatures are approximate and can change depending on travel, road conditions and climatic changes.

we reserve the right to alter, amend, change or modify the tour package and itineraries before or during the tour. We will make reasonable efforts to notify you promptly of such changes as and when they are made.

Such changes may be necessitated due to factors beyond our control such as Force Majeure events, strikes, fairs, festivals, sport events, weather conditions, traffic problems, overbooking of hotels/flights, cancellation / re-routing of flights or railway, closure of / restricted entry at a place of sightseeing. Generally, we try to avoid dates when big Fairs, Exhibitions and other events are held in certain cities as hotels are fully booked several years ahead. If you have to travel on such dates, you may have to stay in alternate hotels or hotels in other cities.
We will make reasonable efforts to keep the overall package of services unchanged. However, we shall not be liable to refund any amount or pay any compensation on account of any change in itinerary.

My Quick Trippers shall not be responsible for any delay or change in programme or expenses incurred or special/consequential loss, injury and damage – directly or indirectly – due to natural hazards, flight cancellations, accident, breakdown of machinery or equipments, breakdown of transport, weather, sickness, landslides, political closures, acts of God, perils incident to the sea, floods, fire, acts of Government or any other authorities, wars, civil disturbances, riots, theft, pilferage, epidemics, quarantines, medical or custom department regulations, defaults, or any other causes beyond our control or any untoward incidents or any such causes whatsoever including any liability or extra expenses sustained by the Clients. Further, the Clients shall be liable for the liability or extra expenses incurred by him/her as a result of the foregoing causes.

My Quick Trippers shall not be responsible and shall not accept any liability towards the Clients or his/her legal representative for any loss of property or damages resulting from death or injuries including loss of services which the Clients may sustain on account of act, negligence or default by any transportation Company, hotel agents or any other body of persons, its agents or service providers providing such services or facilities or arising out of or while engaged in any tour, means of transportation or other services, whether due to ownership, maintenance , use, operation or control of any automobile, bicycle, boat, motor, or other vehicle in common carrier or otherwise and whether due to its or there negligence or otherwise or regardless of how caused. Clients using sporting equipment, bicycles, sailing boats, scuba diving gear, hired or supplied by hotels or rental bodies shall do so at their own risk.

We do not have any insurance policy covering the expenses for accident, sickness, loss due to theft, or any other reasons. Visitors are advised to seek such insurance arrangements in their home country. All baggage & personal property/s at all times are at the client’s risk.
If you wish to amend or change your booking, you have to communicate your request to us in writing. Such requests for change or amendment will be accepted subject to availability.

Notes: (1) The amended or changed booking will be regarded as a new booking; (2) An amendment fee of INR 500 is payable in case of every amendment or change; and (3) In case the amendment is carried out within the cancellation period, then a cancellation charge shall apply as if a cancellation was made on the date the request for amendment or change is made. Please note the cancellation charges specified in the preceding section.

A request in writing for transfer from one tour to another 30 days prior to the departure will be treated as cancellation on that tour and a fresh booking on another. In these cases, a transfer fee of Rs.500/- per person will be applicable in addition to the costs for re-processing your documentation including permits / Rail/cruise / airlines/bus bookings etc. due to the transfer to another tour. In case you transfer within the cancellation period, then the cancellation policy will apply.

Please note that refunds of foreign exchange component of the tour cost will be based on our buying rate of that date. When we receive Indian rupees from you in relation to a booking, we convert them into the foreign exchange component of the tour cost at our selling rate, then applicable. However, when we refund the foreign exchange component to you in Indian rupees, we do so at our buying rate applicable on the date of refund.

(1) If you cause any injury or damage affecting the service provider, then you may be liable to the service provider and if the service provider recovers any monies from us for such injury or damages, we shall separately charge you for the same; (2) We cannot be held responsible for any delay, deficiency, injury, death, loss or damage occasioned due to act or default of such service providers, their employees or agents.

please refer to the itinerary in the website for details of the meals which would be served to you on the tour. Unlike an airline, we cannot process a special meal, nor can we guarantee a special diet. We, however, reserve the right to change the meal arrangement, where circumstances compel us to do so. At some places a meal allowance may be paid to you to enable you to have a meal of your own choice.

As the Client would be out sightseeing most of the time and retire to their rooms only for the night, the Company selects hotels at locations, which give comfort and value for money. Hence depending on the day-to-day itinerary, the hotel confirmed either in the city or away from the city centre. Modern facilities such as attached toilets with showers/bathtubs are provided. We cannot guarantee the availability of adjoining rooms / interconnecting rooms / non-smoking room/rooms on the same floor etc. and are subject to availability. If you seek a change in rooming while on a tour, the same will be subject to availability and you will need to pay any additional charges as may be applicable.

This contract will be governed by Indian law. You agree that in the event of a dispute or difference between the parties the exclusive jurisdiction shall vest in the competent court/ forum/tribunal in Delhi only.
If you have any tips, which you might want to share with us, do write into us at our Registered Office as listed above or email us at feedback@myquicktrippers.com or call to us at +91- 11-45538925.

We have specific training courses, structured course material and quiz programs that can help you become a knowledge expert.

Our team of experts and panel of trainers, who are available at all times for your assistance will hone your soft and hard skills till you become the best in your area of specialization. Of course you understand how valuable these experiences will be when you want to increase your earning potential and career. Working with My Quick Trippers will propel you along a path of holistic career development.

If you have the eagerness to learn, the right disposition and relevant skill set then you will get an opportunity for advancing towards management positions as we can incorporate in or management development program. Internal promotions are encouraged in our enterprises.

Travel Opportunities We have specialized departments at My Quick Trippers owing to our sharp focus on tourism hotspots all across the world. We have multiple international office locations and you can opt for applying for a transfer to your chosen destination. We can also give you an opportunity to work with our overseas suppliers and travel connections. At My Quick Trippers Travel is a passion and we encouraging our employees to travel and imbibe the spirit of tourism.

Excellent Internal Support As an employee of My Quick Trippers you will always get the benefit of being in a cohesively supportive network. You can maximize your selling objectives along with intellectual as well as professional development options by working with us. We have good support in accounting, ticketing, hr, IT, administration and graphic departments. We will offer intensive support at every step to ensure that you achieve your sales target.

Benefit from advanced technology At My Quick Trippers we have always used and possessed a superior knowledge of technology and this accounts for our high standing in the dynamic travel industry. We have a great next generation phone system and a state of the art reservation system. Our staff, customers and business associates all benefit from our technological investments which help us in generating more revenue for our organization.

Enjoy your Mondays here At My Quick Trippers you will actually discover that Mondays are fun as the work environment is extremely exciting and dynamic here. We have a whole bunch of fun events happening throughout the year. These events can be diwali celebrations, birthday celebrations, ganesh chaturthi and so much more. We behave, function and act as a friendly family unit.
